summary: Implementation plan for the Custom Automotive & Vehicle Build Gallery featuring Ed Roth Kustom Kulture styling, multi-file drag-and-drop batch upload, Gemini-powered vehicle classification (make/model/year/craft type), automatic build-stage clustering across five restoration phases (Teardown, Metalwork, Paint, Assembly, Completed), user-fillable metadata fields, aspect-ratio-controlled image generation, and concept modification visualization.
